'''Hunter Maas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pirate/Legends|space pirate]] who, in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], stole the map to the [[hyperspace nullifier]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] designed by the extinct [[K'kybak]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] astrocartographer [[Essio Galassian]]. Maas tried to sell the map to the highest bidder during a conclave of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizers on the planet [[Kiamurr]], but he was killed by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Baasen Ray]].
